TDocOptionsBase.AddImage.text: Keeps a picture in the design and returns its number. A picture that is already there (the same type and exactly the same bytes) is not added again, so inserting or pasting the same picture twice does not make the file bigger.
TDocOptionsBase.AddImage.returns: the number of the picture in the design

TImageResource.Destroy.text: Frees the decoded picture kept for drawing (Cache) with the resource.

TImageResourceList.CreateItem.text: Makes an empty picture to be read from a file.

ReadFileBytes.text: Reads a whole file into memory; False (and empty data) if it cannot be read.

TfrmMain.DoInsertPicture.text: Handler: Insert picture. Asks for a PNG, JPEG or BMP file (the Open dialog's settings are put back afterwards) and inserts it as a picture that follows the mouse until it is placed.

TfrmMain.InsertPicture.text: Insert picture without the dialog: puts any drawing tool away and clears the selection, then inserts the file as a picture that follows the mouse. A file that cannot be inserted (not a picture, missing, damaged, a Windows metafile) is reported and changes nothing.
TfrmMain.InsertPicture.returns: True if the picture was inserted

ReadAll.text: Reads a whole file into memory (test driver).
